name: CICIDS2017 verified preview subset
purpose: Offline bootstrap and end-to-end validation fallback only
notes: Rows are genuine CICIDS2017-derived records transcribed from the public dataset viewer. Only a small feature subset is included so the application has an honest offline baseline. On first startup Mabeli Sentinel automatically attempts to download the repository's 20,000-row public parquet sample and promote a stronger model. The fallback must not be presented as a full-dataset research result.
